title: Lamp Room (example)
style: Fictional characters in a dreamy 1980s synth-pop music video, cinematic, soft film grain.

identities.Maren: a weathered lighthouse keeper with a grey beard and a yellow oilskin coat
identities.Bolt: a small boxy robot drummer with a dented copper body and two round lamp eyes

shots.description: A tall striped lighthouse on a rocky headland at dusk, waves crashing, the beam sweeping the clouds. Slow push-in.
Maren climbs the spiral stairs inside the tower holding a lantern, his shadow stretching up the curved wall.
Close-up of Maren singing the verse into a brass speaking tube beside the great lamp, locked camera.
Bolt plays a drum kit made of buoys and oil drums in the lamp room, sticks blurring, sparks of light on the glass. Locked camera, exactly one robot.
Maren sings the chorus beside Bolt at the drums, the lamp beam rotating behind them. Exactly two characters.
Dawn light on the sea; the great lamp clicks off and the tower falls quiet. Slow pull-back.
